mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollments (course_id, student_id, student_name, course_name, enrollment_status, enrolled_date, progress_percentage) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{courseName}, #{enrollmentStatus}, #{enrolledDate}, #{progressPercentage})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY enrolled_date DESC
SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY enrolled_date DESC
SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT * FROM enrollments ORDER BY enrolled_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollments SET course_id = #{courseId}, student_id = #{studentId}, student_name = #{studentName}, course_name = #{courseName}, enrollment_status = #{enrollmentStatus}, enrolled_date = #{enrolledDate}, completed_date = #{completedDate}, progress_percentage = #{progressPercentage} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND enrollment_status = 'ACTIVE'
